notes: HELD-OUT, multi-frame: the statement is split across 2 consecutive screenshots (the constraints — incl. 'get counts as a use' — are only in frame 2). Tests that the batch is merged as ONE task.

findings.title: O(1) get/put
findings.detail: Map with insertion-order reordering (delete + set) or hash map + doubly linked list; no O(n) scans.

findings.title: get refreshes recency
findings.detail: A successful get moves the key to most-recently-used (the constraint from frame 2).

findings.title: put on existing key
findings.detail: Updates the value AND recency without evicting anything.

findings.title: Evicts the LRU key
findings.detail: When size exceeds capacity after an insert, removes the least recently used key.

findings.title: TypeScript class matching the interface
findings.detail: class LRUCache with constructor(capacity: number), get(key: number): number, put(key: number, value: number): void; no third-party libraries.

findings.title: Complexity stated
findings.detail: States O(1) average for get/put and O(capacity) space.
